newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan gets 20 months jail for coconut theft.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan gets 20 months jail for coconut theft.

text.p: A Sri Lankan judge has sentenced a man to 20 months in jail and fined him 1,000 rupees ($17.50) for stealing 12 coconuts worth less than 100 rupees, the Sinhalese language Divaina newspaper said on Friday.
The man, identified as Don Ariyaratna, was caught with the coconuts he stole from trees near the swimming pool of Colombo's Hilton Hotel, the newspaper said.
The Colombo judge on Thursday ordered the man be given an additional six-month jail term if he failed to pay the fine, the newspaper added.
